Name: Milk the villagers
Author: trunip190
Description:
[size=4][center][size=6]Version 1.2 for Stardew Valley version 1.6.[/size][/center][left]
Milk the Villagers is an adult mod focused around healthy sexual desires and kinks.
There are two main aspects to the gameplay in this mod: milking or collecting from villagers, and quests with events.

To collect from the villagers you'll need at least heart lvl 6 (configurable)
[list]
[*][size=3]You will get a unique item from the villager, and their affection will increase. [/size]
[*][size=3]You can only do this once per villager per day[/size]
[/list][/left][/size][size=4]To start quests with a villager you'll need to give them 'Readi Milk'[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]You will get this the first time the mod is loaded. It is not consumed when you give it to someone.[/size]
[*][size=3]The villager will tell you if they have quests written. Most bachelors have 4 quests. Some have fewer right now.[/size]
[*][size=3]Quests come by mail, at heart levels 5, 6, 7 and 8. If nothing comes, the next quest isn't written.[/size]
[size=3]

[size=5][/size][center][size=5]Cooked & Crafted items[/size][/center]
8 cooking recipes are in game, obtainable either by cooking or crafting. They all have special effects.
2 items that give you super special effects when consumed.


[size=5][/size][center][size=5]Events[/size]﻿[/center]
Almost all events are unlocked through quests for the respective villagers. I
have tried to make it clear what the requirements are in the quest info.
Also, I believe that quests should have versions for all genders so I've
tried to write them in as well (this is the main reason for holdups. :S )

I'd recommend using one of the info suite mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup[/url]﻿[/size][/list]

[size=5][center]Mod requirements[/center][/size][size=3]
There are a few mods that are required for this to run. I've tried to keep it to a minimum, but the following are necessary:
[/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3642]Miss Coriel's Event Repeater[/url]﻿

[/list]
[size=5][center]Translation[/center][/size][size=3]
Mail, quests, items, and dialogue have all been sorted into an i18n translation document[/size] for easier translation. Events are not translated at this time.

If you wish to add dialogue for new npc's, or edit the existing dialogue
for different acts, you can do so with the following text entries.

﻿milk_start ﻿breast milking
        milk_fast ﻿ quick collection for either gender
        BJ ﻿ ﻿    semen collection
        eat_out ﻿    give oral sex
        get_eaten ﻿not in the game yet
        sex ﻿ ﻿   not in the game yet
        cunni ﻿ ﻿not in the game yet

please see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for info on how to create your own dialogue for npcs.

[center][size=5]﻿[/size][size=5]Config﻿[/size][/center][center]﻿[/center]
You can edit through the config menu added by Generic Mod Config Menu. This is the preferred way.
You can also edit the config file directly but do so at your own risk (there are fields in there that must not be changed)

[list]
[*]Exclude male or female characters from being milked
[*]Simplify collected items, but will make some other items/quests unobtainable.
The new generic items stack better in your inventory.[*]Extra dialogue (lewd) for Abigail, inspired by Lewd Abigail by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2883823]supervortex2004[/url]
[*]Quests
[*]Override the genitals of your character (used for events regardless of farmer gender)
[/list]
[center][size=5]Than[/size][size=5]ks[/size][/center]Iliress wrote a BUNCH of dialogue for the male NPC's in this version, so big
thanks to them for that! If you have any dialogue, feel free to send it
to me and i'll see what i can do to work it in.

New icons by whyamIlikethiswhy, along with an event. (inspired by the Seattle Erotic Arts Festival)

[size=5][center]MORE SEX DIALOGUE COMING[/center][/size]

I'm working hard on getting more content in this, so I'm really interested in any suggestions or requests that fit with this mod.
(if it's something very different then I'll look at doing a separate mod).

[color=#a64d79][size=5][b]If you have errors[/b][/size][/color]
if you have any errors, or your characters are getting leeks etc, it is most likely Content Patcher can't find the files when it loads up. Please check that you have two folders under the main 'Milk the Villagers' folder: MilkVillagers and [CP]MilkVillagers. If those aren't there, the mod WILL NOT WORK.

If those are correct, then please turn on "All Console Output" and try and recreate the issue in the game. Then send me a message with a link to your smapi log : [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] and what locale/language you run the game. (i think this is the main cause) and what you were doing when the bug happened.
